context.why: Merge-gate change to FS-030 from the maintainer. (1) Remove the abstract model LocatedRecord (fairdm/contrib/location/models.py): declare location (PointField srid 4326), location_elevation and location_uncertainty directly on Sample (fairdm/core/sample/models.py) and Measurement (fairdm/core/measurement/models.py), with the same verbose_name and help_text, keeping the location_constraints() and geography_index() helpers as plain functions both models call in their own Meta. The database must not change: after the edit, `makemigrations --check` for sample and measurement must show NO changes (if Django sees field differences, fix the declarations, never add a migration). (2) The location code is utilities, not an app: move forms.py, managers.py, coverage.py, resources.py and the helpers into a new package fairdm/utils/location/ (fairdm.utils is already an installed app), and move the widget template to fairdm/utils/templates/location/widgets/location.html (same template name, so nothing else changes). Update every import across fairdm/, demo/, tests/ and docs/ (git grep 'contrib.location' and 'contrib/location'). Move the tests from tests/test_contrib/test_location/ to tests/test_utils/test_location/ to mirror the source tree (check the repo's conformance rule for test layout). (3) KEEP fairdm.contrib.location as an installed app holding ONLY __init__.py, apps.py and migrations/ (0001_initial, 0002_delete_point): historical migrations in sample (0001, 0011) and contributors (0008) depend on app label fairdm_location, and portals such as the Global Heat Flow Database already applied them, so removing the app would break their migrate. Give apps.py a one-line docstring saying it holds only migrations kept for existing databases. Do not edit any historical migration. (4) Docs: remove the locations-page section offering LocatedRecord to portals (the Station example); update paths in locations.md, CHANGELOG.md, CONTEXT.md, ADR 0032 and the spec/plan/decisions (new decision D30 'The location code is a utility package, and the app keeps only its migrations', with an **ADR:** verdict line). No behaviour changes: no test assertion changes, only imports and file locations.
prior_decisions: D1: a location is a value on each record, never a shared row. No Location model, no get_or_create.
D8: no data migration — existing Point data is not carried across.
D12: field names are location, location_elevation, location_uncertainty.

FR-009: a sample type shows the location input only when its registration's fields list location. The demo's RockSample registration is to list location (as the approved prototype did); WaterSample does not.

D3 (decisions): a measurement falls back to its sample's location only for a viewer who may open the sample (Sample.objects.visible_to(user)); for anyone else a measurement with no location of its own has none.
D16: location constraints are listed in each concrete model's own Meta (location_constraints()), not on LocatedRecord.Meta.
Remedies are the smallest edit that fixes the named failure; add no mechanism beyond what the task says.
